shared_preprocessing_facts.event_label_separation: Cue locations define windows. True class labels may be exported for dataset reproduction/evaluation, never used as signal input or to fit inference-time cleaning.
shared_preprocessing_facts.raw_script_execution: Implement bounded, validated adapters; do not import/run original scripts with top-level loops that overwrite data.

mixed_sessions_stratified_70_30.algorithm: Concatenate five sessions. For each sorted class, shuffle indices; n_test=round(class_count*0.30), clamp 1..class_count-1. Take first n_test as test; shuffle final train/test index arrays.
mixed_sessions_stratified_70_30.cross_session_boundary: Despite filename no_cross_session, code mixes all five sessions before a trial-level split. This is not a held-out-session protocol.

SHU_MI.checkpoint_split_lineage: Training scripts only read CxxT/CxxE. They do not record which producer wrote those names. Current file equality does not establish historical checkpoint lineage.

normalization.runtime_policy: Original-workflow preprocessing does not refit a source pool. The specific model adapter applies compatible frozen training statistics once.

default_training_DG_recipe.fit_array: concatenate all declared source-domain arrays along axis=0
default_training_DG_recipe.axes: axis=None: one global scalar across trials, singleton axis, channels and time
default_training_DG_recipe.numpy_reduction_dtype: float32 default accumulation for float32 input; no dtype=float64 override in original source
default_training_DG_recipe.eps_expression: 1e-8 added to std (not variance); NumPy scalar-promotion/version can affect last-bit rounding
default_training_DG_recipe.apply: (x - source_mean) / source_std for every source domain and held-out target

LOSO.source: For each available source subject, concatenate that subject T and E. Exclude the selected target subject entirely from source mean/std fitting.
LOSO.target: Selected target subject T+E, normalized with source statistics. Expected other subjects=8 for A/B or24 for C when all files are present.

subject_dependent_DG.source: Only selected subject T; split into three class-balanced pseudo-domains, then concatenate pseudo-domains for global mean/std.
subject_dependent_DG.target: Selected subject E; not used for mean/std fitting.

single_source_when_use_dg_false.recipe: get_source_data computes np.mean/np.std on complete loaded training array, no dtype cast before statistics and no epsilon; applies these to train/test.
single_source_when_use_dg_false.dtype: inherits stored data: A/B float64, C float32

normalization.unit_contract: For a V-valued inference sample whose model was trained in uV, the specific adapter must reconcile the frozen statistics and original training units (or explicitly restore uV) before normalizing once. Do not blindly reuse uV means/std as V stats.

current_registered_2a_reconstruction.implementation: prepare_local_eeg_skills.py uses float64 streamed sums/squares over current MAT source pool; this differs from original float32 concatenate/reduce.
current_registered_2a_reconstruction.status: reconstructed_source_pool, not saved exact historical training statistics

evaluation_boundaries.target_data_unseen_claim_not_supported: Default DG/DA training builds target_dataloader from held-out test_data, and uses target signals for adaptation. Target is excluded from normalization fit, not from all training-time access.
evaluation_boundaries.checkpoint_selection: Default multi-source loops select best checkpoint by test_acc; target labels therefore influence checkpoint selection. Do not report this as a strictly untouched-target test protocol.
evaluation_boundaries.inference_output: A single prediction is not generalization accuracy, clean-signal ground truth or proof that a new preprocessing profile improves the model.

source_path_boundaries.caveat: Original training working directory is not captured. Relative paths are cwd-dependent; the D: legacy path is absent after relocation. Current local directories are read-only audited copies, not a claim about the old launch cwd.
